result.summary: The empty picker is a rate-limit on uncancelled, retried list walks, not a missing page cap. This only shortens the walk and quietly stops finding older incidents.

problems.title: 429 retries still burn the quota
problems.detail: The client still retries 429 three times with Retry-After. That is the amplifier the description itself cites, and this change does not touch it.

problems.title: Overlapping searches still not cancelled
problems.detail: Each GraphQL search keeps paging with no abort. Several in-flight queries of three pages plus retries can still exceed 60 list calls a minute.

problems.title: Name search silently truncated
problems.detail: High-volume workspaces lose anything older than 750 incidents, or anything after 25 substring matches, with no API or product note. Failed lists still error-log, so Error Tracking remains if 429s continue.

problems.title: Tests restate the new constants
problems.detail: They prove 1 vs 3 pages and a 25-match break, not that typing no longer 429s or that the picker still finds real incidents.

result.betterFix: Stop retrying 429s on this list, fetch one page for typeahead, keep the INC-id lookup, and log remaining 429s as expected rate limits rather than Error Tracking errors.
